name: io.github.cubrid-lab/cubrid-mcp-server
title: CUBRID MCP Server
description: MCP server for CUBRID: 11 read-only tools plus an opt-in execute_write tool, schema resources and prompt templates

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Enforce the read-only SQL whitelist (1). 0 relaxes the whitelist only; execute_query still rejects writes

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in write mode: registers the execute_write tool (single INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE)

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Emit one redaction-safe JSON audit record per executed statement to stderr

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_MAX_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum characters of rendered query output

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_MAX_SQL_LENGTH
environmentVariables.description: Maximum length of a submitted SQL statement, in characters

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_MCP_QUERY_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-statement socket read timeout in seconds

environmentVariables.name: CUBRID_CONNECTIONS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated names of additional connections, configured with CUBRID_<NAME>_* variables
